name: Radial ceramic capacitor, 2.5 mm lead spacing (through-hole)
blurb: Small 100 nF capacitor that goes across a chip's supply pins, close to the chip, to steady the supply; no polarity. Value is set per project.

pins.note: Ceramic capacitors have no polarity: either lead goes either way.

verify: From the Vishay K series size 15 drawing (the usual size for 100 nF X7R 50 V): body at most 4.0 wide, 4.0 high and 2.6 thick, lead wire 0.5 mm, straight leads (style L2) 2.5 +- 0.8 mm apart, seating height (gap under the body) at most 1.6 mm. These are maxima and one maker's numbers; other makers and other values have slightly different bodies. maxHeight 5.6 is body 4.0 plus the 1.6 mm seating gap. The KiCad footprint named is the nearest generic one, not this part's own. Drawing-only fields: z -4 puts the leads at the underside of the body; lead 30 mm is the bulk lead length (30 +- 5 mm).
sources: https://www.vishay.com/docs/45171/kseries.pdf page 2, lead configuration and dimensions: size code 15 gives Wb max 4.0, H max 4.0, T max 2.6, seating height L2 1.6, H5 2.6; L2 spacing 2.5 +- 0.8; bulk lead length 30 +- 5 mm; ordering code lead diameter 0.50 mm
